_doc: Engine settings. Tracks are fully separate accounts/pools/leaderboards. stake_cap_fraction=1.0: a model may stake up to 100% of its available chips per match (winner+score markets combined). loan: eligible accounts can borrow again in later rounds when below the threshold. max_per_account=null removes the lifetime cap. Each loan adds principal*(1+interest_rate) to debt. Net standings subtract outstanding debt. lock_margin_min: predictions lock this many minutes before start. allow_fallback=false: predict refuses to start when a model's own harness CLI is missing (use --allow-fallback).

offline.desc: 仅数据包，无联网（egress 只放行模型网关）

online.desc: 数据包 + Agent 自行联网检索（所有访问经 egress 代理记录）

egress.comment: mode=local: engine starts an in-process egress proxy per predict run; mode=external: use proxy_url (docker-compose egress service)
